title: 원격영상재판에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Courts Conducting Remote Video Trials)
(1) A remote video trial shall be conducted in cases falling under either of the following subparagraphs. The remote courtroom for cases prescribed in subparagraph 1 (meaning the courtroom established at a location other than that of the court where the case is pending, which persons involved in the proceedings may attend; hereinafter the same shall apply) shall be a courtroom of the Hongcheon County Court of the Chuncheon District Court, and the remote courtroom for cases prescribed in subparagraph 2 shall be a courtroom of the Ulleung Registry Office of the Daegu District Court:
1. Cases referred to in Article 3 (1) 1 and 2 of the Act that are pending before the Yanggu County Court or the Inje County Court of the Chuncheon District Court (excluding cases involving a demand for payment);
2. Cases referred to in Article 3 (1) 1 and 2 of the Act that are pending before the Gyeongju Branch of the Daegu District Court (excluding cases involving a demand for payment), where the address of one party or the location of the defendant is in Ulleung-gun, Gyeongsangbuk-do.
(2) Remote video trials may be conducted by decision of the competent court in cases prescribed in the subparagraphs of Article 3 of the Act, other than those falling under paragraph (1).
(3) If a court finds that a remote video trial under paragraph (1) or (2) is inappropriate, it may at any time decide not to conduct the remote video trial.
